scope: Supplemental read-only source audit of TURN client integration, not final independent Fable review and not execution evidence

findings.location: RealtimeLoop.java runVoiceRequest exception catch -> authorityFailure; TextEngine.java Listener.authorizationLost
findings.finding: A confirmed voice 401 queues the generic realtime-generation-only authorityFailure callback. Cancellation/replacement after enqueue suppresses normal deliverVoice but does not suppress this global authority callback; a stale request can terminate a replacement call in the same realtime generation.
findings.basis: Initial source interleaving corroborated by actual pinned HTTPS/JNI red-2 and green runtime tests; original source hashes retained.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep voice authorization failure inside request-scoped delivery and the call-generation checked UI callback, or add equivalent checks at both owners. Preserve generic text authority handling.
findings.test_oracle: Hold owner/UI delivery after old voice 401 twice, cancel and replace that call without restarting RealtimeLoop, release delayed notification; replacement call remains active and no stale authorization loss is applied.

verified_by_inspection: Voice executor has one worker and one queued slot; replacement cancels/removes superseded queued FutureTask
Cancellation marks request before off-owner disconnect; guards check cancellation before sign/after response and deliver checks current request identity
Success metadata remains volatile and native state actions/signing run on supplied owner
Separate pinned-origin voice transport disables proxy, redirects, caches and bounds body size/timeouts
Only pinned 404 or confirmed pre-session legacy capability selects direct; 429/session-busy/malformed 200/other HTTP failures do not
Optional voice 404 bypasses sessionCall invalidation and preserves retained text session
Voice 401 retries once with freshly native-signed nonce; no other implicit credential retries
Controller authorizing state grants no media; generation, permission, setup deadline and adequate wall/monotonic credential lifetime rechecked before engine dispatch
Existing-engine close is awaited before credential request; latest mute/route intent applied before createOffer/createAnswer
Engine uses relay-only policy when credentials present and empty direct ICE only on disclosed compatibility outcome
limitations: Actual TLS cancellation/queue/401/404 and full relay media tests are root-owned and pending for this code checkpoint
